clusters.name: Beasts
clusters.description: Undead beasts upend all laws of nature. Nature’s purpose is to thrive. Undead beasts sow death and  desolation. Yet even they have a master.

clusters.name: Undead Monsters
clusters.description: The shadow of Nagash bids dread colossi out of their element, to challenge his presence. They die and are enchained, nothing but fleeting shadows in his eye.

clusters.name: Construct Monsters
clusters.description: Nehekharans, in their worship, were the first to stamp spirit upon stone. Nagash's triumph over the inanimate is far greater.

clusters.name: Morghast
clusters.description: The Hammurai descended in mortal struggle and always triumphed, except once. Now ghastly reflections of their past selves, they are no lesser.

clusters.name: Lords & Heroes
clusters.description: Spoken of in fear and awe in histories long turned to dust, the great ones among the Undead have bowed under the only name that matters.

clusters.name: Vampire Coast
clusters.description: Sea-faring vampires have wasted their immortality in aimless wandering, seeking "freedom" like mortal children. Their course is now charted forever on.

clusters.name: Vampire Counts
clusters.description: Before they served, they sought to rule like mortals. Lowly ambitions and acting out parts of an inferior life are unnecessary. Nagash’s glory needs no performance.

clusters.name: Tomb Kings
clusters.description: Nagash’s Nehekharan kin claimed immortal glory, and were still claimed by death, which they revered. Death and worship they shall have eternally, in Nagash.

clusters.name: Settlements
clusters.description: Every speck of dust in Nagash’s domain is imbued with his touch, every edifice or ruins is under his eye. The sky itself is bounded by his shadow.

clusters.name: Recruitment
clusters.description: Those who gather for Nagash are marching to the end of all history, clarions silent, banners tattered – dire symbols of Nagash’s will.

clusters.name: Dead Rise Again
clusters.description: Death was once a point of no return. Every passage beyond the veil is a gust of Shyish blowing one way – until Nagash decreed that it should blow the other.

clusters.name: Battles
clusters.description: Nagash brings death none can make peace with – not an impersonal force, but an expression of absolute will. For mortals, no peace is possible, but neither is victory.

clusters.name: Horsemen
clusters.description: The steeds have shed every living excess from their frame so their riders can deliver death in the excess demanded by their master.

clusters.name: Chariots
clusters.description: Chariot wheels hailed a Nehekharan ruler's arrival, and that of certain victory. It has never been more certain now when they serve Nagash.

clusters.name: Knights
clusters.description: A legacy of barrow-mounds and faded crests, and memories of an unstoppable advance awaken anew as steeds are mounted for the last time.

clusters.name: Zombies
clusters.description: The ghoulish and grave-rotted, the living that do not live, the dead who do not stay so – all of them Nagash’s instruments to pry the world open and for him to sup on its marrow.

clusters.name: Skeletons
clusters.description: The mortal purpose which these bones is now dust. The living core is gone. Shyish is their marrow now, and purpose is much greater.

clusters.name: Ethereal
clusters.description: Spirits trapped in confusion,wandering lost, sunken to the depths and buried under stone are bent to their purpose by a greater darkness.

clusters.name: Guards
clusters.description: A  warrior's pride is misused by a petty ruler’s frail claim to power. Nagash has excised such failings. Service to greatness is what remains.

clusters.name: Vampires
clusters.description: Though not his creation, Vampires have inherited Nagash's utter arrogance. They still seek to show themselves the first and most superior among Nagash's servants.

clusters.name: Polearms
clusters.description: Forests of long-hafted weapons shall rear up from the hollow earth and there remain after the end, still as trees, the air black with iron.

clusters.name: Swords & Shields
clusters.description: Blades and arrows cannot fight death. A shield bearing the marks of service to Nagash is a constant reminder of how foolish such beliefs are.

clusters.name: Great Weapons
clusters.description: After they reap, there will be no further sowing. The world will be a cold cairn, the tomb-silent, its roads forever haunted.

clusters.name: Dual Swords
clusters.description: Nagash's will is the eye of a storm. The storm itself is these warriors’ blades. In its wake, souls swirl in Shyish, still unaware of their death.

clusters.name: Winds of Magic
clusters.description: No wizard can truly bend the Winds to their will though some well know their nature. But Nagash’s way has ever been to impose his nature over all he touches.

clusters.name: The Lore of Undeath
clusters.description: Across the point of no return, a world awaits that is the darkest mirror of existence, a void that will eat away at the core of every being, save one. Nagash.

clusters.name: The Lore of Death
clusters.description: Everything dies. Malignant daemonic essences, mortal memory, arcane paths to ascension - all try to defy it. Yet none changes the essence of this truth: Nagash.

clusters.name: The Lore of Vampires
clusters.description: Blood courses through flesh and time, but some find ways to steal it to make their flesh timeless. What they stole, Nagash always possessed.

clusters.name: The Lore of Shadows
clusters.description: What we almost see – but not fully – we fear. All souls dwell in shadow and fear that it will swallow them. The shadow of all shadows is Nagash.

clusters.name: The Lore of Nehekhara
clusters.description: Nehekhara's power arose out of worship. Even the great kneel to something greater. The road to divinity never ends. Yet through Nagash, it will.

clusters.name: The Lore of the Deep
clusters.description: In the depths sinks the flotsam of body and soul. The tides of peace and struggle come and go, but the deep waits eternal, as does Nagash.

clusters.name: The Lore of Light
clusters.description: The purest light is that of oblivion. In the light, one is nowhere. It blinds the eye and empties the mind, making it a twin of darkness, and both are one in Nagash.

clusters.name: Archers
clusters.description: Beyond the mortal veil, the very air belongs to death, and every speeding arrow riding on it will always find its target.

clusters.name: Guns
clusters.description: As the seas dry up and the fraught lives of those who sailed them begin their course in unlife's element, their devastation shall know no bounds.

clusters.name: Deck Droppers
clusters.description: No living being would dare fly in a winged beast’s claws, for fear of a dire drop to the bottom. For Nagash, a deathly drop is inevitable, for there is no bottom.

clusters.name: Siege Monsters
clusters.description: A gigantic construct of war's shape on the horizon makes mockery of hope. They lay waste to all illusions of permanence, for such illusions must end.

clusters.name: Arkhan the Black
clusters.description: Through the centuries, as Arkhan laboured alongside Nagash, he learned that this work, also, begins with servitude, a sacramental ritual unto itself.

clusters.name: Mannfred von Carstein
clusters.description: In the dark of night, Mannfred's mind excelled at scholarship and lowly cunning, and his thirst for power grew to rival his thirst for blood.

clusters.name: Vlad von Carstein
clusters.description: A being of unassailable force, Vlad’s monstrous shadows of human passion and obsession have inured him against fear, even from Nagash. Even so, he shall serve.

clusters.name: Neferata
clusters.description: Secretive even as Lahmia’s Queen, Neferata eventually found refuge in that secrecy. Yet Nagash sees all, for she was ever his unwitting, if precocious, student.

clusters.name: Luthor Harkon
clusters.description: No one can plumb the depths of Luthor Harkon's mind, for it is an abyss, blind and unfathomable. His shattered self is half-undone. The rest belongs to Nagash.

clusters.name: Krell
clusters.description: Krell has ever walked the path of bloodshed and despair. His master's goal may be to end all despair, but first the world will have its share in Krell.

clusters.name: Dieter Helsnicht
clusters.description: A Necromancer's morbid infatuation with death finds its fullest form in Dieter Helsnicht. The power pales to the depths of such devotion.

clusters.name: Walach Harkon
clusters.description: None can stay Walach Harkon's charge towards glory. But no Vampire can outrun their thirst. Some claim his sire Abhorash could. Walach simply does not want to.

clusters.name: The Nameless
clusters.description: An immortal spirit unshackled, and possesed of raw power, it vowed its service to reclaim its name and its shattered mind - a boon yet to be bestowed.

clusters.name: Nagash
clusters.description: None of his Nagash's past failures were such. They were steps along his way to become what he is now, and the path to his pinnacle and the end of all else is at its conclusion.

clusters.name: Shambling Hordes
clusters.description: Nagash's hordes sprout into existence from the dust he leaves behind, and to the dust they will return, but not before they heap yet more of it upon the world.

clusters.name: Infernal Legions
clusters.description: Where Nagash walks, the legions follow. They swell not just at his behest, but at the mere trace of his mark upon the land, growing by the moment.

clusters.name: Gunpowder Artillery
clusters.description: A  warrior's pride is misused by a petty ruler’s frail claim to power. Nagash has excised such failings. Service to greatness is what remains.

clusters.name: Magical Artillery
clusters.description: A soul’s silent memory and a skull’s gaping stillness are every mortal’s fate. Yet it is time souls wailed and  bones screamed once last time.

clusters.name: Magical Chariots
clusters.description: Bearers of the writ and wealth of a kingdom which cannot be beggared and whose ruler cannot be opposed.
